summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various enhancements and proposals, including the integration of Iceberg with Spark and optimizations for Parquet read paths. Notable topics include support for repartitioning old partition spec data files and the implementation of dedicated sync for materialized views.
highlights: Integration updates with Spark and removal of Spark 3.4 support
Support for repartitioning old partition specification data files
Optimizing Parquet read paths by reducing S3 GET requests
Proposal for table-level quantile sketches in Spark's Cost-Based Optimizer
